<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex22032023-09-181" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" next="ex22032024-10-1509-181"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon Part 1 (40b2-5) (p. 122:2-5)"/>
            <lb n="40b2"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4633"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3693">sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa</rs>'i bshad sbyar</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6961"><choice><sic>slos</sic><corr>slob</corr></choice> dpon <abbr>ye shes</abbr> zhabs</rs> kyi dgongs pa la 'khrul pa spang pa'i phyir | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5878">shag kya'i <choice><sic>rge'</sic><corr>dge</corr></choice> slong <abbr>ye shes</abbr> rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis sbyar ste'o || rdzogs so|| × || × || <lb n="40b3"/> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5656">rgyan dkar × phug<anchor xml:id="a1"/><note type="editorial">There is no place with this name in BDRC, however in Vitali's The Book of Names (2015: 539) he says that 'Bre Shes rab 'bar (ID: 3807) "[...] was at rGod po lung (earlier known as rGyan dkar gong ma) which was renamed as rGod po khung, since 'Bre chen po received rGod kyi khung there." It is uncertain if this is the same place.</note></rs> du bris so || × ||</seg></TEI>
